tools.name: kopt_find
tools.description: Search code by identifiers or plain words (case- and camelCase-insensitive). Use before grep or opening files. Returns ranked path:lines + #handles. mode "pack" adds the best bodies (task context in one call). path: prefix/glob; kinds: e.g. ["class","function"].

tools.name: kopt_read
tools.description: Read exact code by #handle, Class.method, path or path:start-end. mode: body (default), skeleton (signatures only; big files/classes), card (~60 tok). Use instead of whole-file reads. Already-shown code returns 'unchanged' (fresh:true resends).

tools.name: kopt_outline
tools.description: Structure map with #handles of the repo (no path), a directory or a file (much cheaper than reading it). focus: task words ranked first.

tools.name: kopt_refs
tools.description: Callers/usages (direction in, default), callees (out) or both of a #handle or Class.method. depth 2 = transitive impact.

tools.name: kopt_run
tools.description: Run a shell command (tests, build, lint) in the repo; returns only failures, errors and summary. Use instead of the shell for verbose commands. An identical re-run with no file change returns the cached verdict (fresh:true forces). Full log: kopt_expand.

tools.name: kopt_expand
tools.description: More of a kopt_run log by handle: grep (regex, with context) or startLine/endLine.

instructions:
kopt = budgeted code index, the cheapest way to get context. Flow: kopt_find (search) -> kopt_read #handle (exact code; skeleton for big files) / kopt_refs (callers) / kopt_outline (structure).
Prefer these over grep, directory listings and whole-file reads. Reuse #handles; shown code is not re-sent.
Run tests/builds via kopt_run (compact output); re-run only after edits.
